title: Loyi A Vuriweke Hi Mavito Endlwini Ra Muprofeta
intro: Endlwini ya murhumiwa wo hetelela, a ku hanya moya-xiviri lowu mhaka ya wona ya munhu hi xiyexe yi veke dyondzo ya Xikwembu eka vapfumeri hinkwavo. Vutomi bya munhu loyi a byi fambisana swinene ni xileriso lexi hundzulaka lexi vumbeke mikhuva ya ntshamisano hi vuntshwa hilaha ku nga heriki, leswi fungheke ku cinca lokukulu eka ndlela leyi ripfumelo a ri ta hlamusela ndyangu ni ku va xiphemu xa vona ha yona.
clues: Vito ra mina ri tshame ri hlanganisiwa ni rixaka ra xiyimo xa le henhla, kambe ntiyiso lowu tlakukeke endzhakunyana a wu ta hlamusela swiboho swa ntiyiso swa ripfumelo.
A ndzi ri muamukeri wa tintswalo letikulu ku suka eka Allah na murhumiwa wa Yena, tintswalo leti a ti tivisiwa erivaleni eBuku.
Vutomi bya mina bya vukati byi ve ndzingo wa nkoka lowu a wu ta cinca hilaha ku nga heriki langutelo ra vuxaka bya vana lava amukeriweke.
Hi mina loyi ku ringiwa ka yena ka munhu hi xiyexe ku yiseke eka xileriso xa Xikwembu lexi pfumeleleke Muprofeta ku teka wansati endzhaku ka loko ndzi fambile.
Hi xitori xa mina, ku hambana exikarhi ka ndyangu wa ntumbuluko na lowu hlawuriweke ku vekiwile erivaleni eka tinxaka hinkwato.
Hi mina ntsena exikarhi ka tintangha ta mina loyi vito ra yena ri humelelaka hi ku kongoma eka nhlavutelo yo hetelela, ku nga ri tanihi muprofeta, kambe tanihi nandza la ringiweke ni ku xiximiwa.

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, ku vula yena
Zaid ibn Haritha, loyi a nga ni vuxiyaxiya
Ali ibn Abi Talib, ku vula ka yena
identity.answer: Zaid ibn Haritha, loyi a nga ni vuxiyaxiya

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Ku herisiwa ka ku amukela vana tanihi ndlela yo tumbuluxa vuxaka bya ngati
Ku simekiwa ka mfumo wo sungula wa Vuislem
outcome.answer: Ku herisiwa ka ku amukela vana tanihi ndlela yo tumbuluxa vuxaka bya ngati

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
